rotation_rule: A lens chooses where to start, not what may be skipped. Each worker covers every source line/clause across successive invocations, then repeats the full manuscript with a different lens/order. Advance the initial slot lens cyclically after a complete full pass.
comparison_rule: Derive first; then compare against a separately executed worker's source-pinned evidence. Record provenance. Copied PASS, self-review and repeated votes do not constitute independent reconstruction.
native_prompt_policy: Preserve existing logical account/slot, hourly cadence, enabled/paused state and notifications off. Only an authorized local updater or the same account's B20 under its exclusive hour lease aligns its twenty existing prompts. No new tasks or cross-account authentication.
legacy_assignment_cards: Superseded for work selection by this matrix and ORDER. Historical files remain preserved and are not authorization for former research tasks.
